id./param/scenario/cs/c_100_cs_020.pack|cs_:
"Those eyes... The gentle light in them...
  Surely not... can it be...!

"I see... It was you who freed me
  from the brink of despair.
  You've grown so fine, {var:1}...!

"...Ah, I can't believe it.
  Is it you? Eleanor...

{var:1} freed you from the curse
that tormented you.
Now we can depart in peace...

Many hardships will stand before you still.
But walk straight on regardless.

The light of hope within you will surely
guide you. Your father and I
will always watch over you.

Goodbye, {var:1}...
I have always loved you so...

"...This is truly farewell, then.
  Irwin, Eleanor...
